fund_page_notes.TPOP: Shown at the pool. NAV, assets, liabilities, subscriptions, redemptions, income and net change from operations are T-POP US Aggregator’s, which holds TPOP and a parallel vehicle. TPG charges its fees above the Aggregator, so management fees, performance allocation, total expenses and net investment loss are TPOP’s own lines. They leave out the parallel vehicle’s fees and the share of the management fee TPOP’s tax-exempt feeder pays, and the rows marked estimate gauge the whole pool from the contract rates and TPOP’s interest in it. The Aggregator’s redemptions include what its holders withdraw to pay those fees, so they run well above investors’ own. Monthly subscriptions are the pool’s from October 2025, but monthly NAV is TPOP’s own, since the pool’s is printed only quarterly. Per-unit NAV and returns are TPOP’s, after fees. Class R-I leads because it has the full record; it pays a lower management fee than Class I until 2028.
